▸ Imitative Speaking Repetition Non-verbal communication Intonation Engagement

Teach
• Focus skill: use fluent speech patterns for.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Imitative Speaking Repetition Non-verbal communication Intonation Engagement.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Imitative Speaking Repetition Non-verbal communication Intonation Engagement
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

1. How do you read with good tempo?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.
